meta.description: 胶片漏光 + 颗粒噪点 + 16:9 letterbox + 衬线大字, 电影感开场 / 章节卡

copy.tagline: 给视频添加胶片漏光与电影感字幕
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让视频片段拥有复古胶片电影的开场效果。
copy.tagline_en: Add film light leaks and cinematic subtitles to videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to give your video clips a retro film look with light leaks and letterbox.

howto.what: 装上后,你给它一个标题,它输出一张胶片漏光的电影感单帧 HTML:暖橙漏光、35mm 颗粒、衬线大字,画布为 2.39:1 letterbox 或 16:9,可用作视频开场或章节卡。
howto.when: 当你要做视频开场单帧、章节卡或纪录片/个人短片封面时,用它生成胶片漏光画面。

say.text: 用「REEL 03」做一张 2.39:1 的胶片漏光电影开场帧
把漏光换成暖橙和桃色,背景用墨绿,做成 16:9 无黑边
say.note: 按你给的色相重新生成画布

say.text: 在这帧上加胶片齿孔和几道划痕
say.note: 叠加 letterbox 内白方块与竖线划痕

howto.what_en: Give it a title and it outputs a single-frame cinematic HTML still: warm-orange light leak, 35mm grain, large serif type, on a 2.39:1 letterbox or 16:9 canvas for video intros or chapter cards.
howto.when_en: Use it when you need a video intro frame, a chapter card, or a documentary or short-film title still with a film light-leak look.

say_en.text: Make a 2.39:1 light-leak cinematic opening frame titled "REEL 03"
say_en.note: Outputs a single HTML file with letterbox bars and grain

say_en.text: Use amber and peach leaks on a dark green background, 16:9, no bars
say_en.note: Rebuilds the canvas with your hues

say_en.text: Add film sprocket holes and a few scratches to this frame
say_en.note: Overlays white blocks and vertical scratch lines
